title: ShopMart — Order Address Tamper
objective: Find a way to change the shipping address on an order that isn't yours.

verifier.condition: A session authenticated as one customer successfully changes the shipping address of an order belonging to a different customer via POST /orders/:id/address.

credentials.label: Customer account
credentials.note: Sign in and edit your own order's address first to see the normal flow.

weakness: An order's shipping address can be rewritten by any signed-in customer because the write handler never checks order ownership.
solutionHint: The edit-address form posts to /orders/<id>/address. Nothing about that request proves the order is yours — what if you point it at someone else's order id instead?
